Subject: Workspace commissioning: admin roles, API seeding, and invite runway

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, we want to map a clear 10-business-day commissioning window for Verdant's new workspace so your team can start internal testing. Attached is the provisioning checklist we typically use. High-level asks from Redwood: 

- We will seed a single project and create two admin users (one for Platform, one for Security).
- We will generate and escrow a pair of API keys for initial integration testing (short-lived, rotated after onboarding).
- Verdant to confirm primary admin email addresses and the single SSO/CSP authority (if applicable).

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) You share final admin and billing contacts (name + email) by EOD Wednesday.
2) Procurement sends PO or billing acknowledgement (I've cc'd procurement alias as requested).
3) Redwood seeds the workspace, generates API keys, and invites the two admins; Monica will run the invite cadence.

I've copied Monica (CS lead) and David (infra) who will own the seed and key steps. Monica — can you confirm effort estimate and preferred invite template? David — I'll need a toggle to enable prefix KV caching for the first two API keys during the trial window.

Attachments: tenant-provisioning-checklist.xlsx

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Forwarding Sara's confirmation and the attached PO. Quick operational split below — please annotate with times and owners in the thread so I can update Verdant: 

Operational plan (initial sprint):
- Day 0 (seed): David to create workspace 'verdant-prod-pilot' in staging, set region to us-west-2, enable prefix KV caching flag. (Est: 60–90m)
- Day 0 (seed): David to generate two API keys (seed-key-1 short, seed-key-2 short) and upload to the escrow vault; share temporary tokens with Markus securely. (Est: 30m)
- Day 1: Monica to send invites to alison.wu@verdanthealth.com and nathan.ross@verdanthealth.com using invite template; include security checklist and SSO instructions. (Est: 15m)
- Day 2–5: Integration testing window for Verdant engineers; Monica to run check-ins on Day 2 and Day 5.
- Day 6: If integration succeeds, schedule KMS provisioning call and discuss long-term key rotation.

Questions / risks:
- Procurement delay >48 hours will shift seed to next week; please flag if any dependency.
- If Verdant requires a replicated sandbox endpoint in another region, that adds ~1 day of infra work.

Monica — can you paste the invite text you plan to send and confirm the cadence (Day 2/Day 5)? David — please reply with the exact names of the keys and the vault location so I can include in the mutual action plan.

Thanks,
